decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (JS 01/01, dated March 2013, received 26/06/13; JS 01/02, dated July 2013, received 22/08/13; and JS 01/03, dated August 2013, received 16/08/13) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extensions hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the side walls of the extensions hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - The extensions hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as No. 48 Broad Walk, Hounslow.
Condition : 6 - The proposed first floor side window shall be obscure glazed before the extension is first brought into use and shall be so retained permanently.
description: Erection of a two storey side extension, part two storey part single storey rear extension and rear roof extension to the house
